products.title: Armchair - Zefir - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: With Zefir, Studiopepe combines design with artisanal mastery to craft an artwork that boasts a strong and distinctive presence. A tribute to lightness, this chair with its curved T-shaped backrest catches the eye with its perfect balance of geometric rigour and sinuous lines. Crafted from matt black metal, the unique backrest structure ascends like a graphic signature that shapes the space, softly embracing the guest. The leather upholstery, soft to the touch and made entirely by hand, transforms everyday comfort into an aesthetic and sensual statement. Zefir enriches the scene with its subtle balance between strength and grace, leaving a distinctive impression of strong personality.

products.title: Armchair - T Chair - By Federico Peri
products.description_html: The T Chair by Federico Peri is a minimalist design marvel, seamlessly merging practicality with understated elegance. The chair's geometric design is characterized by the distinctive 'T' shape of its padded backrest, an iconic feature that embraces the user, providing both comfort and personality to the design while imparting a sense of security and robustness. The seat's structure, crafted in polished glossy or matt black brushed wiredrawn aluminium, is welded at sharp angles and harmonizes with the inviting padding of the cushions, creating a captivating visual contrast. With its sober and decisive style, T Chair is a versatile piece of furniture, perfect to complete any environment, from the contemporary living room to the most formal dining room.

products.title: Armchair - Summer Arms - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Summer Arms armchair by Paola Navone, with its sleek and enveloping form, captures the essence of comfort through a distinctive and elegant design. The essential lines are enhanced in comfort and appeal by generous leather upholstered cushions featuring sharp edge stitching. The armrests emphasize the feeling of warmth and comfort, making the chair a perfect spot for engaging conversations around the dining table or worktop. For greater functionality, a version with castors is also available, perfect for appreciating the conviviality of the most lively settings.

products.title: Armchair - Stig - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Stig is a leather-covered chair whose design, by Roberto Lazzeroni, is inspired by the ironic furniture designed by Jean Royère. The chair’s distinguishing element is the base that becomes a sculpture and makes this small work of cabinet-making unique and immediately recognisable. It is a solid, thick sled made of wenge ash which, when raised, supports the seat and backrest. The two leather-covered cushions rest lightly on the structure and invite you to experience the unusual comfort of this statuesque piece.

products.title: Armchair - So Far - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Studiopepe's So Far chairs, with their luxurious upholstery, pay homage to an iconic design by blending 1970s influences with a modern elegance that feels as welcoming as an embrace. The tubular metal structure defines a bold and distinctive stage presence, which harmoniously dialogues with the soft and enveloping lines of the oversized seats. The combination of metal (available in hand-brushed burnished or glossy chrome finishes) and leather-covered cushions expresses a welcoming personality with timeless charm, able to enrich any living environment with style and versatility.

products.title: Armchair - Oslo - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Exuding minimalism and comfort, the Oslo chairs and stools by Paola Navone feature straightforward geometries that are perfectly complemented by luxurious leather upholstery, achieving an ideal blend of elegance and adaptability. The raw-cut stitching on the upholstery, exclusively available with leather legs, imparts a material sense to each chair and stool. Both functional and iconic, these chairs seamlessly fit into any setting, eliminating the distinctions between the living room, dining area, and workspace.

products.title: Armchair - Nepal - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Nepal chair, a bold creation by Paola Navone, redefines the concept of contemporary seating through a compelling contrast of elements: the extraordinary tactile softness of Mongolian fur envelops and embraces, while the solid frame outlines strong, architectural lines within the space. Each Nepal chair becomes a full sensory experience—an island of comfort that captivates at first glance and delights at first touch. The natural upholstery, available in a palette of luminous and vibrant hues, captures and transforms light, creating a magnetic focal point in any setting. Nepal is far more than a furnishing accessory—it is a stylistic statement that transforms its surroundings with exuberant presence; a living sculpture that invites both tactile and visual exploration.

products.title: Armchair - Miss Rope - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Striking and regal, Miss Rope is the woven paper cord chair by Studiopepe that, with its elongated design and high backrest, evokes the ceremonial seats and tribal thrones of far-off places. The weave draping the metal structure reflects the artisan's handiwork, where meticulous and steady movements bring the creation to life. The vertical lines, reminiscent of sculpture, convey the sitter's significance. Thanks to its expertly hand-crafted cord, Miss Rope is a majestic enhancement to both indoor and outdoor settings, owing to its remarkable resilience against outdoor conditions.

products.title: Dining Chair - Marilyn - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: Marilyn is the chair upholstered in soft leather that celebrates the idea of the “diva” according to designers Draga & Aurel. Available with or without armrests, it offers a versatile elegance, adapting effortlessly to various comfort and style needs. The swivel seat is wide and comfortable with voluptuous forms that are embraced by a light, aerodynamic shell which seems to defy gravity. With its vintage and fluid design, the chair is reminiscent of a padded nest, a soothing embrace that both cuddles and guarantees supports and freedom of movement. In the armrest version, the seating experience becomes even more enveloping, while the armless model maintains a sleek, essential line—perfect for dynamic interiors and compact spaces. The leather upholstery of Marilyn transforms under changing light, revealing subtle nuances and textures that add visual depth to its already striking presence. Versatile and distinctive, Marilyn enhances any setting with its sophisticated personality—from the dining room to the living area, and into the study. The option to customise the upholstery with an exclusive palette of colours allows this designer chair to integrate seamlessly into any interior concept—creating a focal point of undeniable allure.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones Mouton - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Lazybones Mouton is a sculptural chair with mouton upholstery designed by Studiopepe with the idea of creating a three-legged seat inspired by monoliths and primitive architecture. Characterised by archetypal forms, the chair plays with the structure’s massive volumes contrasted with the softness and comfort of the padding and mouton upholstery. Lazybones is characterised by three oversized, solid and imposing legs that emphasise its archaic solemnity. Its solid design fluidly interacts with the rounded, generous shapes of the backrest, making it ideal for leisure and social occasions.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Lazybones is a sculptural chair designed by Studiopepe with the idea of creating a three-legged seat inspired by monoliths and primitive architecture. Characterised by archetypal forms, the chair plays with the structure’s massive volumes contrasted with the softness and comfort of the padding and leather upholstery. Lazybones is characterised by three oversized, solid and imposing legs that emphasise its archaic solemnity. Its solid design fluidly interacts with the rounded, generous shapes of the backrest, making it ideal for leisure and social occasions.

products.title: Armchair - Jorgen - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Striking a balance between modern elegance and classical nuances, Roberto Lazzeroni's Jorgen chair displays a design that combines premium materials and meticulous details, achieving a perfect synergy of aesthetics, comfort, and functionality. The spacious seat, gracefully widened for arm support, is covered in soft leather and adorned with a subtle tone-on-tone decorative detail that emphasises its visual harmony. The wengé-stained ash base is distinguished by its sculptural stability, complemented by metal tips available in three refined finishes: satin brass, hand-brushed burnished metal, or satin nickel-plated metal. Every feature of the Jorgen chair embodies balance, comfort, and precision, transforming it into a piece of furniture that honours the seamless interaction between wood, leather, and metal.

products.title: Armchair - Jodie - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Taking inspiration from palaver-style seating, the whimsical chairs in Christophe Delcourt's Jodie collection best express the ideal of sharing, inviting guests to lounge and relax. The sinuous roundness of the forms enhances the designer's architectural choice, resulting in a refined interplay that shifts between sturdy, assertive lines and gentle, welcoming structures. The precious leather that covers each chair makes Jodie's sculptural lines extremely comfortable, in a masterpiece of design that provides a memorable seating experience.

products.title: Armchair - Inga - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Designed by Roberto Lazzeroni for Baxter, Inga is a collection comprising a high stool and chair that effortlessly merges Italian elegance with enveloping comfort in a refined, contemporary design. A natural evolution of the Inga pouf, the stool and chair are defined by their slender base and ergonomically shaped backrest that gently supports the sitter. The open cylindrical structure integrates a practical metal footrest, while the leather-upholstered padding offers an unparalleled comfort experience. Available in two different heights, Inga blends naturally into modern kitchens, islands and counters, as well as enhancing premium contract spaces. A subtle tone-on-tone decorative profile highlights the craftsmanship and attention to detail—making Inga a true symbol of contemporary high-end design.

products.title: Armchair - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines domestic and outdoor spaces with ethnic-inspired chairs in natural, organic shapes that recall the typical motifs of African design and art. Delicate and harmonious, the solid wood seats designed by Roberto Lazzeroni elevate interiors in the version with leather cushions and can also be used on the terrace and in the garden when upholstered in weatherproof fabric or leather.

products.title: Armchair - Ginestra - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Magnetic and sculptural, Ginestra is the iconic metal rod chair designed by Antonino Sciortino for Baxter. From its circular seat to its majestic backrest, the chair features a matt black painted metal rod frame that gives spaces a rhythmic and dynamic feel, punctuating them with precise graphic contours. An interplay of geometric shapes alternating solids and voids, complementing the vertical appeal of the high backrest and giving the seat an unmistakable style and very striking effect.

products.title: Armchair - Gemma - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its ethereal profile, the Gemma leather chair by Draga & Aurel interprets the design codes of the 1960s, bringing them to centre stage in the dining room, study or living room. Versatile and unique, this alluring vintage chair engenders an atmosphere of consummate elegance thanks to the interplay of solids and voids created by the joints between the backrest and the armrests, and between the soft upholstery and the solid metal rod frame.

products.title: Armchair - Dolly Baby - By Doriana & Massimiliano Fuksas
products.description_html: Dolly Baby is a comfortable quilted leather chair characterised by a formal, composed and elegant design by designers Doriana & Massimiliano Fuksas. The slender legs in matt metal (with feet in a choice of finishes) and the tactile appeal of the leather upholstery, created using a special chequered quilting technique, make Dolly the ideal seat for those who love a more classic style combined with a strong, unusual personality.

products.title: Armchair - Corinne - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Roberto Lazzeroni designed the Corinne chair with the idea of reinventing the concept of hospitality through an extraordinarily calibrated design, simple only in appearance. Its essential profile, defined by fluid and decisive lines, reveals an elegance that is expressed in the details. The upholstered backrest, elongated with a refined design trick, extends gracefully to accommodate the arms, creating an illusion of armrests. The solid wenge-stained ash frame creates a formal contrast that dialogues with the enveloping softness of the upholstered seat and backrest. The upholstery, in leather or sheepskin, adds an irresistible tactile dimension, turning every encounter with Corinne into a unique sensory experience.

products.title: Armchair - Colette - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The refined design of the Colette and Colette Office chairs is inspired by what Roberto Lazzeroni calls “the infinite catalogue of memory”. The classic profiles of the two chairs, upholstered in the finest leather, recall the elegance of yesteryear, a simple yet assured style that fully embodies the link between past and future, between convention and experimentation. Baxter's own meticulous research into materials is evident in the way it pairs leather - a living, evolving element with a story to tell - with fine woods to create completely original combinations. The possibility of customising every chair - choosing between the materials, the armrests, the comfort of the armchair version - makes Colette a unique and exclusive piece, an iconic chair that enhances any space: from the office to the dining room, from the bedroom to the living room.

products.title: Armchair - Clotilde - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: An ideal complement for any table – not just in the dining room – Roberto Lazzeroni’s Clotilde chair stands out for its light and minimalist look, which reworks the vintage design of 1960s chairs with a bolder, more distinctive image. Clotilde has an ebonised ash or walnut frame, available in two different finishes, which supports the upholstered seat and backrest cushion. Through a clever design, the backrest has been extended so that it embraces the guest and allows functional support for the arms, without the need for armrests. The chair therefore becomes a new classic, a perfect icon on its own or combined with Baxter tables.

products.title: Armchair - Afra - By Baxter
products.description_html: With Afra, Baxter reimagines the armchair, elevating it to a sophisticated creation entirely wrapped in the tactile embrace of leather. Its ashwood frame—offered in a natural finish or in the deep tones of wenge-stain—traces elegant, sweeping lines that cradle the upholstered backrest, flowing seamlessly into arms that invite both comfort and contemplation. This masterfully composed design strikes the perfect balance between visual presence and lightness, transforming Afra into a timeless furnishing piece. Whether standing alone or placed gracefully around a dining table, this chair expresses a quiet yet unmistakable elegance, defining the space with the distinctive character and refined artistry that mark every Baxter creation.

products.title: Armchair - Thea - By Draga & Aurel
Armchair - Taipei - By Paola Navone
Armchair - Taipei - By Paola Navone
Sofa - Tactile - By Vincenzo De Cotiis
products.description_html: The Tactile armchair and quilted sofa collection showcases the tangible properties of leather with a statuesque design that gives the products a museum-like appearance and underlines Vincenzo De Cotiis' close attention to detail.

products.title: Armchair - Stromboli - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Stromboli armchair, a revolutionary vision by Paola Navone, boldly challenges the conventions of elegance in contemporary furniture design. In this unique creation, Baxter leather is freed from formal constraints to express its natural inclination for movement—shaping a landscape of folds and ripples that make each piece truly unrepeatable. The visual and tactile effect is surprisingly organic and vibrant—almost sculptural—inviting a deeply sensory experience. Stromboli celebrates imperfection as a superior form of beauty, with a contemporary design language that recalls the expressive fluidity of natural forms. This exclusive designer armchair is far more than a furnishing element: it is a manifesto of creative freedom, transforming the living space into a dynamic environment—an invitation to break free from convention and embrace a new, boundless dimension of elegance.

products.title: Armchair - Stig - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Stig is Roberto Lazzeroni’s armchair with armrests, a statuesque and playful piece whose inspiration comes from designer Jean Royère and his naively ironic furniture. The armchair’s sculptural design is characterised by a solid base consisting of a wenge-stained ash sled that supports the seat, back and armrest, comfort elements upholstered in soft leather. Satin metal or hand-brushed burnished finish details add a vintage sophistication to the armchair, which becomes the standout element of any room.

products.title: Sofa  - Sorrento - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, the Sorrento furniture collection comprises a sofa and armchair with classic forms and generous dimensions, which here become a nest, a cradle, a refuge. The strong and rigorous frame with contrasting edges accommodates soft goose down cushions, as voluminous and light as clouds, in which to sink. The leather upholstery invites you to sit back in total comfort and includes small contrasting details reminiscent of mattress stitching. Designed for complete relaxation, the large armchair and sofa have a reassuring effect, transmitting a sense of calm and wellbeing in any environment.

products.title: Armchair - So Good - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Comfortable and sophisticated, the So Good armchair by Studiopepe encapsulates the essence of a design that is as essential as it is sophisticated, combining 1970s influences with extra-comfortable elegant lines. The tubular metal frame gives the armchair a sculptural presence, ideal for enhancing spaces that require furniture with a strong aesthetic impact. The leather upholstery of the oversize seat, a pivotal element with enveloping lines like a cloud, creates a harmonious dialogue between the different materials, offering exceptional comfort. The visible stitching of the cushions and the precious metal finish highlight the exclusive character of the piece, which is a true icon of style and versatility.

products.title: Armchair - Pochette - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A timeless and extremely comfortable design that, on closer inspection, reveals unique details and elegant handmade decorations. Paola Navone's Pochette armchair is the perfect combination of classic shapes, timeless elegance and absolute comfort. The armchair is adorned with delicate decorative stitching that traces its contours, forming gentle folds in the leather exterior. Like a shell, it cradles the plush upholstery of the seat, enticing guests to relax against the elegant headrest cushion.

products.title: Armchair - Pillow - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: Enveloping and reassuring, Pillow is a soft armchair that guarantees both elegance and comfort, just like all Baxter pieces. Like any masterpiece, Hannes Peer's design is iconic in its simplicity: a balanced game of contrasts between the simple lines of the frame and the abundant forms of the seat, which seems to levitate, as light and airy as a cloud. The temptation of being pampered by the extra-large leather cushion is irresistible. The promise of an embrace that invites you into a new dimension of relaxation.

products.title: Armchair - Pedro Indoor - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Infused with sculptural elements and material details, the Pedro collection's indoor armchair and ottoman introduce artistic presences featuring exotic and essential lines into domestic areas, fostering a sophisticated and welcoming ambience. For the indoor armchair, Roberto Lazzeroni designs a welcoming low seat with a generous, comfortable round cushion, crafted from premium indoor leather, and others leather cushions to lean against the high backrest reminiscent of thrones and tribal chairs. The enveloping metal frame varnished with refined details is designed to blend harmoniously into the interior, offering comfort and style in every season.

products.title: Armchair - Olaf - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Olaf leather armchair fully represents Roberto Lazzeroni’s ethnic-inspired design. Olaf is a low armchair with an ironic, sculptural design that recalls African art. The seat and backrest, which extends to become an armrest, are upholstered in leather and, with their sinuous curves, supported by sturdy legs reminiscent of elephant legs, invite you to take a relaxing break.

products.title: Armchair - Nina - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Nina ottoman by Roberto Lazzeroni represents a new classic for convivial occasions. With its wrap-around backrest, the Nina's welcoming and elegant design seamlessly integrates into any setting, providing an ideal spot for enjoying moments with friends. The leather ottoman has a circular seat, which develops vertically outlining soft and essential shapes, contained by a decorative profile in the same colour as the seat and backrest or in contrasting colours. The soft upholstery guarantees comfort and well-being, enveloping the entire structure and preserving its striking presence over time while staying faithful to its iconic design aesthetic.

products.title: Armchair - Nepal - By Paola Navone
Sofa - Milano - Paola Navone
products.description_html: Born from a desire for maximum comfort, Paola Navone's Milano collection includes the sofa and three leather armchair versions (corner armchair, small armchair, and bergère with swivel base) with generous dimensions and a design of enveloping and reassuring extra-large volumes. These sofa and armchairs are warm, welcoming retreats, drawing inspiration from the comfort of home, embraced by soft, cloud-like forms. The workmanship of the leather — quilted like a mattress and decorated by beautiful squared stitching — invites you to sink into the oversized padding and immerse yourself in total relaxation.

products.title: Armchair - Mickey Extra - By Baxter
products.description_html: With its gracefully curved armrests and welcoming upholstered design, the large Mickey Extra armchair is an elegant classic that brings a comfortable touch to any space. The decorative leather profile, offered in both matching and contrasting shades, accentuates the armchair's rounded and inviting design, encouraging relaxation on its generous structure with armrests and goose-down cushions. Elegant and timeless, the Mickey Extra is a large upholstered armchair that perfectly embodies Baxter's vision of refined and sophisticated living.

products.title: Armchair - Mickey - By Baxter
products.description_html: With its gracefully curved armrests and welcoming upholstered design, the Mickey armchair is an elegant classic that brings a comfortable touch to any space. The decorative leather profile, offered in both matching and contrasting shades, accentuates the armchair's rounded and inviting design, encouraging relaxation on its generous structure with armrests and goose-down cushions. Elegant and timeless, the Mickey is an upholstered armchair that perfectly embodies Baxter's vision of refined and sophisticated living.

products.title: Armchair - Marilyn - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The leather armchair designed by Draga&Aurel is an easy chair with a wide and comfortable seat, an ultra-light and streamlined shell with a vintage feel, and sinuous and generous forms. These are the standout features of Marilyn. Its fluid profile is reminiscent of an enveloping and comfortable nest in which to snuggle down, a warm embrace in which to sit back and relax. The swivel seat gently cradles while guaranteeing freedom of movement. Attractive yet sophisticated, young and original, thanks to its leather upholstery the armchair not only adds character to spaces but also texture and depth.

products.title: Sofa - Leon - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The majestic, rounded design of the Leon sofa and swivel armchair created by the Draga & Aurel duo simultaneously conveys security and seduction with its curvy, original contours. Spirited, generous and bold, the Leon collection blends contrasts and extremes with an elegant and sophisticated harmony. On the one hand, a firm and dynamic approach, enhanced by the imposing dimensions of the pieces. On the other, an enveloping and protective roundness, which is fully expressed in the tactile sensation of the soft leather covering the seats, made even more inviting by sensory details such as pleats, reliefs and tailored stitching.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones Mouton - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: As a perfect combination of Studiopepe's visionary design and the enveloping softness of natural mouton, Lazy Bones Mouton rewrites the rules of comfort. This sculptural armchair stands out for its mouton upholstery available in delicate shades of air force blue, white and cream, blue, olive and turquoise, inviting you to relax with an unmistakable tactile sensation. The essential structure finds a harmonious balance thanks to its distinctive three-leg configuration, a detail that combines stability and visual lightness. The rounded lines and the wide, welcoming profile of the seat turn Lazy Bones Mouton into a piece of furniture capable of enriching any space with personality, be it a refined living room or an exclusive reading corner.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Lazybones is a sculptural chair designed by Studiopepe with the idea of creating a three-legged seat inspired by monoliths and primitive architecture. Characterised by archetypal forms, the chair plays with the structure’s massive volumes contrasted with the softness and comfort of the padding and leather upholstery. Lazybones is characterised by three oversized, solid and imposing legs that emphasise its archaic solemnity. Its solid design fluidly interacts with the rounded, generous shapes of the backrest, making it ideal for leisure and social occasions.

products.title: Armchair - Keren - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Keren is an innovative collection of soft leather armchairs and ottomans designed by the eclectic Christophe Delcourt for Baxter. Inspired by nature’s geometric shapes, Delcourt’s design perfectly interlocks organic and bevelled forms to create a small armchair with a harmonious seat and compact dimensions complemented by a sculptural ottoman. Two furnishing elements that dialogue in a perfect balance, capable of enhancing any room, from the living room to the dining room.

products.title: Armchair - Jorgen - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Jorgen armchair collection encapsulates all the enveloping elegance that characterises Roberto Lazzeroni's design in a harmonious dialogue of shapes and materials. The structure is as essential as it is comfortable, supported by a base in wengé-stained ash enriched with metal tips available in refined finishes: satin brass, hand-brushed burnished metal, or satin nickel. The soft leather upholstery is embellished with a decorative piping that echoes the leather tones of the backrest and seat, achieving a sophisticated chromatic continuity. The armchair's flowing, cosy lines invite you to relax, while the balance of wood and leather lends a distinctive character, ideal for adding style and warmth to spaces.

products.title: Armchair - Inga - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: An exclusive creation by Roberto Lazzeroni for Baxter, the Inga pouf captivates with its minimal, refined charm. Its gently flared cylindrical shape features carefully placed openings at the front and back, lending the piece a pleasing visual lightness and a modern aesthetic. The small, curved backrest blends seamlessly into the base, embracing the sitter with understated comfort—ideal for welcoming contemporary lounge spaces. Fully upholstered in fine leather, this elegant pouf embodies the excellence of Baxter’s Italian design, making it the perfect addition to exclusive living rooms, distinctive interiors, and luxury hospitality environments.

products.title: Armchair - Houston - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Comfortable and eclectic, the Houston armchair designed by Paola Navone for Baxter is the result of the creative impulse of a design that is both versatile and multifaceted. The armchair's simple, elegant contours are made unmistakable by an innovative design that combines materials as diverse as the brushed ash wood of the base, the polished cast aluminium shell, and the soft leather that covers the seat and back cushions. The armchair’s distinguishing feature is its contrast between rigidity and softness, between the support of the shell and the soft padding that creates the effect of an enveloping cot in which to experience moments of comfort and togetherness.

products.title: Armchair - Housse Extra - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Cosy, comfortable, and elegant, the Housse Extra armchair designed by Paola Navone for Baxter takes the experience of comfort to the next level with its iconic extra-large seat. The design is classic and refined, made monumental by a solid frame that supports the generous volumes of the upholstered cushions, ready to welcome you for a relaxing break. Like a fabric, leather covers the armchair’s soft elements, finishing it off with refined stitching that enhances its sophisticated, informal style.

products.title: Armchair - Hakuna Matata - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Hakuna Matata is the solid wood armchair designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to celebrate moments of quiet relaxation both indoors and out. The name itself is a statement of intent: “carefree” in Swahili, it advocates a slower and more rejuvenating approach to moments of relaxation and rest. Its reassuring sculpted design is inspired by African art and its alternation of defined and compact curves invites us to abandon ourselves in its generous embrace.

products.title: Armchair - Greta Special Edition Printed - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Special Edition Printed version of the sophisticated Greta armchair features two new, exquisite decorations on the leather upholstery with eclectic and unusual prints and patterns, making the seat an example of style and creativity. The leather is screen-printed by hand with prints inspired by 1950s textile archive designs, transferring textures usually associated with fabrics to leather. The frame designed by Draga&Aurel is reclining, wide and comfortable, finished in shellac and featuring wide edging in satin-finished brass, hand-brushed burnished metal or nickel-plated and satin-finished metal. The soft upholstery of the seat and back cushions ensures enveloping comfort, making Greta the perfect chair for relaxing and social moments.

products.title: Armchair - Greta - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its cosy and sophisticated design, the Greta armchair by Draga&Aurel invites you to relax and enjoy the comfort that the reclining seat inspires from the first glance. Large and inviting, the armchair’s comfortable seat is distinguished by the functional ergonomics provided by the tilt of the base structure, which accompanies the guest into an oasis of relaxation. The statuesque solidity of the frame, edged with a fine metal finish of your choice, is balanced by the softness of the upholstered seat and backrest cushions, upholstered in leather in a variety of colours, patterns and textures, including the eclectic Greta Special Edition Printed print.

products.title: Armchair - Ginevra - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Ginevra armchair by Paola Navone reinterprets the classic bergère, transforming it into a contemporary refuge of pure comfort. A soft architecture of skilfully orchestrated cushions creates a seating experience that embraces and supports with extraordinary naturalness. Baxter leather, chosen for its exceptional lightness and flexibility, reveals a natural elegance that adapts effortlessly to form, creating a landscape of waves and folds that speak to the authenticity of the material. Every detail reflects a liberation from formal constraints: the swivel base brings dynamism to the seating experience, while the matching pouffe completes this oasis of relaxation. Ginevra is not simply a designer armchair: it is a daily invitation to rediscover the pleasure of surrender. A distinctive element that enhances any contemporary interior with its welcoming presence.

products.title: Armchair - Etienne Bergère - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Blending art and design, the Etienne Bergère armchair combines the sculptural features typical of Roberto Lazzeroni with elegant contours reduced to their essence, creating a sense of lightness thanks to the swivel metal base detail. This majestic and sinuous bergère armchair naturally encourages contemplation in the enveloping curves of its seat cushions and high leather-upholstered backrest, which seems to want to embrace the user. The addition of soft cushions and the ability to construct the shell and seat with different leather and colour variants make Etienne Bergère even more unique and versatile.

products.title: Armchair - Elli - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Featuring a compact design formed by interlocking rounded geometric shapes, the Elli armchair by Christophe Delcourt is an eclectic seat that attracts attention in any room. Without armrests, like the palaver chairs that inspired it, Elli combines architectural design with an idea of comfort and sharing that invites idleness and conversation. The result is an interplay of soft, refined shapes, enhanced by the comfortable upholstered cushions of the wide seat and backrest.

products.title: Armchair - Diner - By Piero Lissoni
products.description_html: An armchair with an authoritative personality and classic, timeless design. Diner is the elegant armchair designed by Piero Lissoni for Baxter, the result of a continuous pursuit of formal essence and pure lines, made unusual by the inviting design of the armrests. Available in numerous leather versions, Diner is the ideal home armchair with its understated comfort, made even more complete by the option of adding footrest ottomans and large upholstered cushions.

products.title: Armchair - Dalma - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Dalma tufted leather armchair and sofa by designers Draga&Aurel elevate every space with sophisticated, incisive elegance, the result of a minimalist design that blends the vintage contours of ’60s furniture with those of classic tufted sofas. The backrest upholstery in soft, hand-quilted leather provides a pleasant tactile sensation and is the hallmark of Dalma seating. The supporting structure of the small sofa and armchair is made of black lacquered beech wood or Canaletto walnut, a material that also envelops the back of the backrest, which curves to invite the guest in like a welcoming gesture.

products.title: Armchair - Dabliou - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Designed by Studiopepe for Baxter, the Dabliou armchair is an outdoor piece that distils the spirit of Italy’s legendary 1960s beach resorts into a contemporary expression of elegant ease. Its design, a perfect balance between clean lines and carefully measured proportions, combines visual lightness with reassuring solidity—thanks to the use of a coloured tubular metal frame that sketches a timeless geometric silhouette. The padding, crafted to coexist gracefully with the natural elements and endure their shifting moods, welcomes the body in a soft, embracing gesture—never compromising on aesthetic clarity or elegance. Dabliou makes a subtle statement in outdoor environments, turning panoramic terraces, private gardens, and poolside areas into unique, character-filled settings—where design is not only seen, but felt. An essential, versatile piece, Dabliou is ideal both as a standalone statement and as part of a curated composition, creating a refined and harmonious living setting.

products.title: Armchair - Charlotte Longe - By Giuseppe Manzoni
products.description_html: Charlotte Longe by Baxter embodies a refined reinterpretation of classic design, combining tradition and comfort in a harmonious balance. The padding and leather upholstery provide enveloping comfort and optimum support, while the wooden feet, enhanced by elegant castors in polished brass or chrome-plated metal, combine functionality and style. To complete the proposal, Charlotte Longe is paired with a coordinated footrest ottoman, perfect for elevating the relaxation experience and providing additional versatility. A piece of furniture that blends naturally into both classic and modern interiors.

products.title: Armchair - Bruxelles - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Paola Navone’s comfortable and eclectic design is perfectly expressed in Bruxelles, the comfortable armchair with a large silhouette that invites you to indulge in a totally relaxing break. The result of a creative and functional drive for comfort, the large armchair has a minimalist, almost rigorous design that makes it suitable for any context. The raw-cut stitching on the leather invites a tactile experience, while the deep seat contrasts with the geometric shape of the leather-covered armrests and tubular supports, creating an appealing balance of opposites.

products.title: Armchair - Wunjo
products.description_html: Structure in plywood and in solid wood, polyurethane foam in different densities Memory Foam® and acrylic ﬁbre padding, backrest upholstery with capitonné rhombus pattern and seat cushion with light quilting. Back cushion in goose down, front feet in turned aluminium in chromed/golden/bronzed ﬁnishing and rear feet covered with fabric or leather. Option: decorative insert in the armrest in semi-precious stone or briar wood/veneer.

products.title: Armchair - Whitney
products.description_html: Armchair upholstered in leather or fabric, structure in curved plywood and solid wood equipped with elastic spring belts, padding in polyurethane foam with different densities , externally covered in leather or fabric with cannetté quilted decoration, seat and backrest in contrasting leather and fabric. Base structure in stainless steel available with any ﬁnish included in the metal ﬁnish selection.

products.title: Armchair - wallis
products.description_html: Armchair upholstered in fabric or leather not removable. Structure in solid pinewood and poplar plywood. Spring system with elastic belts. Expanded polyurethane padding. Capitonné pattern on the backrest. Seat cushions with goose down and Memory Foam® inserts. Front armrest in plywood upholstered in leather or fabric with chromed brass decorations, turned and chromed aluminium feet partially upholstered in leather. Metal parts can be lacquered in any colour of the metal finish selection.

products.title: Armchair - Sontag
products.description_html: “Diamond” shaped structure in solid wood and plywood, seat with spring system with straps and padding in polyurethane, Memory Foam® and acrylic fibre. Internal parts of the back in polyurethane and acrylic fibres padded individually. Multi-faceted base in polished stainless steel available in the metal finishing selection.

products.title: Armchair - Rosemary
products.description_html: Seat and backrest structure in curved plywood, elastic straps springing system; base structure in poplar plywood and beech solid wood, upholstery in leather or fabric. Internal padding in polyurethane with different densities and Memory Foam®, embedded within a feather-proof lining, ﬁlled with down. External upholstery quilted with cannetté motive. Decorative friezes and front feet in satinized stainless steel. Metal parts availa-ble in the satinized metal ﬁnishing selection. Available in the ROSEMARY RADICA version with the upper back in burr walnut with a 100 gloss ﬁnish.

products.title: Armchair - Petra
products.description_html: Armchair in leather and fabric, external structure in curved wood equipped with elastic spring belts. Backrest and armrest provided with vertical structural elements in stainless steel. External structure upholstered with a geometrical pattern and piping in Soft leather. Metal parts can be lacquered in any colour included in the metal finish selection.

products.title: Armchair - Mira
products.description_html: Armchair upholstered in leather or fabric. Internal frame in multilayer wood padded with differentiated density polyurethane with rounded volumes, backrest fixing bracket in satin-finish cast aluminium with "orbital" finish. Metal parts are available in the metal finish selection.

products.title: Armchair - Mercury
products.description_html: Armchair upholstered in elastic fabric. Main structure in solid wood and plywood. Seat equipped with elastic spring belts. Padding in polyurethane foams with different densities and acrylic fiber. The base consists of a five spokes star in black steel and feet in solid wood with tips in brass lacquered in any colour of the polish metal finish selection.

products.title: Armchair - Mac Arthur
products.description_html: Structure in curved poplar plywood. Seating sprung system with elastic belts covered with a padding of polyurethane foam, a layer of Memory Foam® and acrylic. Base in polished stainless steel or gold/bronze lacquer, with swivel system. Upholstery in fabric or leather not removable. On request, as optional, “lindoro” embroidery can be applied over each side and “Visionnaire” logo embroidered on the rear.

products.title: Armchair - Loving F.
products.description_html: Armchair upholstered in leather or fabric, with base composed of a frame in satinized stainless steel and a panel in wood and metal covered in leather or fabric, equipped with elastic belts for the seat suspension. Seat cushion in polyurethane with different densities, memory foam® and feather. Back cushion in polyurethane and feather. Metal parts available in the satinized metal ﬁnishing selection. Available in the BACKSTAGE RADICA version, with external shell in burr walnut with 100 gloss ﬁnish.

products.title: Armchair - Legend
products.description_html: Structure in solid wood and plywood with elastic straps, padding in polyurethane with different densities. Upholstered in leather or fabric. Quilted backrest. Base composed of a five-star steel base in black and solid wood feet equipped with brass feet, available in the metallic finishes selection.

products.description_html:

Imagine armchair designed by Mauro Lipparini results winner of the International Design & Architecture Awards Design Et Al, seating category.

products.title: Armchair - Holden
products.description_html: Padded armchair upholstered and leather or fabric. Frame made of plywood and solid wood blocks, a shaped backrest and a seat cushion with fixed upholstery. The seat and backrest covering are available in leather or fabric. The rearback is available with plain upholstery or quilted with basket embroidery, slightly padded and finished with a perimetral trim. The backrest is equipped with included double loose cushions individually sewn and entirely filled with feathers, with a micro-perforated venting band for the leather version. The base is made of shaped wood and covered in leather or fabric, also in contrast. The support feet are set back from the edge and made of wood.

products.title: Armchair - Grace
products.description_html: Armchair and love seat with double upholstery, structure in solid wood and poplar plywood. Metal parts available in the “GRACE colour” version and upon request in the satinized metal ﬁnishing selection.

products.title: Armchair - Foster
products.description_html:

products.title: Armchair - Elain
products.description_html:
Elain, is a cosy, curvacious, little armchair designed to fit easily into any setting. Consisting of just two parts, a seat and a backrest, which come together to form a perfectly rounded object that invites you simply to sit down. Ideal for use alongside sofas also designed by Vincent Van Duysen, or even on her own as a comfy armchair or with a twin to create discreet little conversation corners.

Elain is not just a stay at home chair but one that loves to make an appearance in public hospitality spaces such as hotel or office lobbies. Whether upholstered in quality textiles or in soft leather, Elain is always herself: a pretty, sophisticated little chair, featuring snug, welcoming lines, thanks to the padded seat and back.

Internal armrests and backrest in convex polyurethane and seat in polyurethane with variable density and acrylic layer, with elastic belt springing. Body in mat painted ash solid wood.

Seat and backrest cushions made of differentiated density polyurethane foam and Memory Foam®, covered with a quilted fabric with a stripe or diamond pattern. Loose cushions in feather. The wooden parts are available in 100-gloss polished finishes in selected essences and burl walnut. Stainless steel support base available in selected metal finishes.
